patthana3.14:144.1: araṇaṃ ajjhattārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo ajjhattārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana3.14:145.1: hetuyā dve ārammaṇe dve avigate dve. sahajātavārepi pañhāvārepi sabbattha vitthāro.
patthana3.14:146.1: saraṇaṃ bahiddhārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo bahiddhā rammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana3.14:147.1: araṇaṃ bahiddhārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo bahiddhārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana3.14:148.1: hetuyā dve ārammaṇe dve avigate dve. sahajātavārepi pañhāvārepi sabbattha vitthāro. saraṇadukaajjhattārammaṇattikaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
patthana3.14:149.1: araṇaṃ anidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana3.14:150.1: hetuyā ekaṃ adhipatiyā ekaṃ avigate ekaṃ. sahajātavārepi pañhāvārepi sabbattha ekaṃ.
patthana3.14:151.1: saraṇaṃ anidassanaappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana3.14:152.1: araṇaṃ anidassanaappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana3.14:153.1: saraṇaṃ anidassanaappaṭighañca araṇaṃ anidassanaappaṭighañca dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana3.14:154.1: hetuyā pañca ārammaṇe dve avigate pañca. sahajātavāropi sampayuttavāropi vitthāretabbā.
patthana3.14:156.1: saraṇo anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo saraṇassa anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo: tīṇi. araṇo anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo araṇassa anidassanaappaṭighassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo:.
patthana3.14:157.1: hetuyā cattāri ārammaṇe cattāri avigate satta.
patthana3.14:161.1: yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomampi paccanīyampi anulomapaccanīyampi paccanīyānulomampi gaṇitaṃ evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ. saraṇadukasanidassanattikaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ. piṭṭhidukatikaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ. anulomadukattikapaṭṭhānaṃ samattaṃ.
